meta.title: x/tools/gopls: documentHighlight from subpackage selects usage for parent package
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@933c7ccb1545 (internal/lsp/source: use exact match in import highlighting)
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with go1.20.4 (golang.org/dl, under temp/lsp_servers/go-sdks); the server runs with that Go first on PATH (toolchain.json). The reporter used go1.20; go1.20.4 was the current Go release when v0.12.0 was tagged. The local go1.27 cannot build v0.12.x (internal/tokeninternal array-length check).
meta.notes: Old code: highlighting from an import path string highlighted every package name contained in the path as a substring, so 'httptest' also selected uses of 'http'. The fix matches the imported package object exactly.

settings_note: The maintainer's reproduction names no settings (the reporter's buildFlags -tags=integration play no role in it).

files.source: comment by suzmue on 2023-05-25 (repro case, main.go)

files.note: module path and the go directive of the era (the maintainer's reproduction is a single-file module in a directory)

repro.steps: Open main.go, which imports net/http and net/http/httptest and uses http first. Request textDocument/documentHighlight on 'httptest' inside the import path "net/http/httptest" (line 4, character 15, the position in the maintainer's trace). Expected: the httptest import and its use only; reported: the http.CanonicalHeaderKey use is selected too. Probe: every highlight in the file must also be a reference of the same symbol (references at the same position, declaration included).
